text:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release v3.12.0-canary — canary aborted due to staging-smoke failure on nodepool 'gpu-small-3'. Job: staging-smoke/42 exit 255. Auto-pausing promotion and notifying owners. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/staging-smoke/42

maya: saw the alert, only failing on gpu-small-3, other nodepools show green. Is this a flaky test or infra?

chris: quick log dump: ```
[2026-03-21T13:03:51Z] ERROR load_model: allocation failed at alloc.c:234
Test: smoke_gpt_end_to_end
Step: load-model
Exit code: 255
```

maya: thanks. Did we rotate runner images recently?

jenna: we rolled runner-image:v2026.03.21 about 2h before. It landed on gpu-small-3 first.

sre-oncall: looking at node metrics now — gpu-small-3 shows OOM spikes around 13:04 and a bunch of pod restarts. Other pools fine. Could be the new runner-image interacting badly with that pool size/driver.

maya: options: (A) pin canary job to previous runner-image and rerun; (B) rerun on different nodepool and if green, manual promote; (C) block promotion until we root-cause. Given release window, prefer quick unblock with minimal risk.

chris: agree. Recommended flow: 1) pin runner-image to v2026.02.15 in the canary job spec (temporary) 2) trigger rerun on stable nodepool 3) if pass, manual promote to canary and hold prod until postmortem. I can draft the PR for the pin.

maya: ok. I'll take PR ownership. @jenna can you trigger rerun once PR merges?

jenna: merging PR now with the pin. Commanding rerun after merge: `ci retry staging-smoke --job=42 --nodepool=default`

deploy-bot: Rerun queued: staging-smoke/42 (attempt 2) on nodepool 'default'. Notifying logging/traces.

[jenkinsbot] build-42: started on nodepool default.

jenna: rerun started. Monitoring logs: https://ci.internal/logs/staging-smoke/42?attempt=2

[~12 minutes later]

jenna: rerun passed on nodepool default. GPU pool gpu-small-3 still exhibiting OOMs when we tested there manually.

maya: thanks. Since rerun passed with pinned runner-image and different nodepool, I'm going to request manual promote to unblock canary. We'll document the pool instability and keep prod rollout in next change window.

maya: `deploy-bot promote --release v3.12.0 --target canary --reason "staging-smoke transient on gpu-small-3; pinned runner-image" --manual`

deploy-bot: Manual promotion accepted. Canary promotion completed. Production rollout scheduled for change window 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

chris: created postmortem ticket INF-4567 to investigate runner-image rotation impact on gpu-small-3 and note mitigation steps. Added link to PR 2345 (temp pin) and logs.

sre-oncall: I'll follow up tomorrow to repro on gpu-small-3 and check driver/kernel mismatch with v2026.03.21. If needed, we'll rollback the runner-image cluster-wide.

tara: Added a brief note to release notes: "Canary experienced transient runner-image instability on gpu-small-3. Temporary pin to previous runner image applied for this canary; full investigation in INF-4567."

maya: sounds good — closing thread once prod rollout completes. Thanks everyone :pray:
